title: IGV signal QC prep pipeline parameters
description: Extracts one lead SNP per finemapping credible set, maps BAM-having individuals to their genotype dogID, extracts genotypes at those SNPs, and selects candidate individuals per genotype class for manual IGV read-pileup review.

finemap_results_dir.description: 3_finemap_susie's published finemap/ output directory (*_NO_PRIORS.*.gz finemapper.py result files).

qc6_plink_dir.description: 3_Merging_filtering's published plink/ output directory (holds both QC5 and QC6 files; DA_MERGED_GENCOVE_AXIOM_QC5.{bed,bim,fam} are used here).

crosswalk_fam.description: Deposited raw data file, not built by any pipeline: DA_MERGED_GENCOVE_AXIOM_QC3modi.fam. Doubles as the sampleID<->dogID crosswalk (has both columns; predates 3_Merging_filtering's dogID relabel).

n_per_class.description: Individuals to select per genotype class (0/1/2) per lead SNP.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible individual selection.

round.description: Selection round (1-indexed). Increment for a fresh, non-overlapping batch of individuals if an earlier round's picks had no usable reads at a locus.
